title: Designing an Iterative Multi-Agent Writing Pipeline
objective: Explain how a five-agent pipeline turns a brief into a reviewed draft through bounded iterations, and what a reader must decide before adopting the pattern in production.
audience: engineers building LLM workflow tooling who care about cost control and auditability
constraints: explain the decision gate before the agent loop
cover the token budget policy explicitly

sections.title: Introduction
sections.purpose: frame why unbounded agent loops are expensive and hard to audit

sections.title: The Decision Gate
sections.purpose: explain how invalid input is rejected before any agent spends tokens

sections.title: Mandatory Agent Roles
sections.purpose: describe the five roles, their fixed order and what each one owns

sections.title: Token and Memory Policy
sections.purpose: explain context caps, priority eviction and the rolling summary
